action.summary: Fixed model_to_dict() to return an empty dict when fields=[] is passed by changing 'if fields' to 'if fields is not None'. The fix was applied to the first occurrence in django/forms/models.py (line 86) while leaving the second occurrence (line 434) unchanged. This ensures that passing an empty list explicitly results in an empty dict, as expected.
